_comment: delphi-project.json — project-level overrides for the delphi-project skill.
_comment2: Place this file in the project root. Omit sections to use skill defaults.
_comment3: NOTE: encoding rules (UTF-8 BOM, CRLF) are Delphi requirements and are NOT configurable.

naming._comment: Variable and type naming prefixes. Change to match your team's existing conventions.

paths._comment: Project directory structure. outputPath and dcuPath must use MSBuild variables.

header._comment: Default values for unit header template. Override per project.
header.author: Team Name

delphi._comment: Default Delphi target version for new projects.
